title: OpenAI's ad business shows blistering growth, hits $1 billion annualized revenue run rate
summary_full: OpenAI's move to serve ads in ChatGPT earlier this year drew ridicule from its chief rival, Anthropic, in the form of a Super Bowl commercial.
